title: Resolution-level pro-étale section map
statement:
Let $\Omega$ be an algebraically closed field, $P=\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], $\Lambda$ an arbitrary discrete commutative ring, and $a:Z\to P$ a proper morphism of schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Work with sheaves of modules over the constant ring sheaves of value $\Lambda$ and their derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Write $A_T=\nu_T^*$ for the exact comparison inverse image [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. For $F\in D^+(Z_{\Et},\Lambda)$, let $I$ be a bounded below complex of injective etale module sheaves representing $F$, and let $j:A_ZI\to J$ be a quasi-isomorphism to a bounded below complex of injective pro-etale module sheaves [lem-sc-bounded-below-injective-resolution]. Let
$$\beta_{a,F}:A_PRa_{\Et,*}F\longrightarrow Ra_{\mathrm{proét},*}A_ZF$$
be precisely the fixed derived underived restriction mate [def-weil-pbc-fixed-derived-comparisons], whose invertibility is [prop-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image]. Use the resolution models for direct images [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], the point-section identification $\Gamma(P_{\mathrm{proét}},A_PH)=\Gamma(P_{\Et},H)$ [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-sections], and exactness of point sections [det-pe-wc-sections-exact], [lem-weil-pbc-geometric-point-pullback-stalk]. Under these identifications, applying point sections to $\beta_{a,F}$ gives precisely the morphism represented by
$$\Gamma(Z_{\Et},I)\longrightarrow\Gamma(Z_{\mathrm{proét}},A_ZI)\xrightarrow{\Gamma(j)}\Gamma(Z_{\mathrm{proét}},J),$$
where the first arrow takes each section to its inverse-image section. Thus it is the canonical cohomology comparison $R\Gamma(Z_{\Et},F)\to R\Gamma(Z_{\mathrm{proét}},A_ZF)$ of [sk-prop-sf-comparison], not just some isomorphism between those objects. The equality is natural in $F$ and is independent of the resolutions under their canonical derived identifications [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-hom-derived].
